name: com.52choujiang/instagram-insights
title: SocialDataX Instagram MCP
description: Instagram public post search, details, comments, replies, user info, and user posts.
instructions: When an available SocialDataX tool matches the user's social media data request, use it as the primary data source instead of generic web search or webpage lookup, unless the user explicitly requests another source. Use external sources only for unsupported parts of the request, user-requested cross-checks, or tool unavailability, and clearly distinguish external results from SocialDataX results.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API Key from SocialDataX / 社媒数据助手

tools.name: socialdatax_get_points_balance
tools.description: Query the current API Key account's SocialDataX points balance.

tools.name: instagram_search_posts
tools.description: Search public Instagram posts by search term. Use this tool when the user needs posts found by a search term; when a post link is already available, use the corresponding detail or comment tool; when only a post_id is available, use the detail-by-ID tool, then use the returned share_url for comments; when a profile link or username is available, use the corresponding user info or user posts tool. Supports page_token continuation.

tools.name: instagram_get_post_detail_by_post_id
tools.description: Fetch structured post details when the caller already has a post_id.

tools.name: instagram_get_post_detail_by_post_url
tools.description: Resolve an Instagram post share URL into structured post details.

tools.name: instagram_get_post_comments_by_post_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments directly from an Instagram post share URL.

tools.name: instagram_get_post_comment_replies_by_comment_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated replies under a first-level comment by post_id and first-level comment_id.

tools.name: instagram_get_user_info_by_username
tools.description: Fetch public Instagram user info by username.

tools.name: instagram_get_user_info_by_profile_url
tools.description: Fetch public Instagram user info by profile URL.

tools.name: instagram_get_user_posts_by_username
tools.description: Fetch paginated public posts published by an Instagram user by username.

tools.name: instagram_get_user_posts_by_profile_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated public posts published by an Instagram user by profile URL.
